howToPlayStep1: Choose a difficulty level by clicking on one of the three dots. The easiest level is on the left.
howToPlayStep2: The timer will count down 3 seconds so you have time to get ready.
howToPlayStep3: Depending on the selected level, you will see a grid: 3x3 for Easy, 4x4 for Medium, and 5x5 for Hard.
howToPlayStep4: One of the boxes will light up green. Click on it before time runs out, otherwise the game is over.
howToPlayStep5: The game starts at a relaxed pace for Easy level, and a faster pace for Hard level.
howToPlayStep6: Each successful click earns you 1 point, and a new green box will appear immediately.
howToPlayStep7: Keep playing as long as you can and test your reaction speed!
